STANDING NOTES
1. If you have not been scheduled for 3 consecutive work days, inform the ODO.
2. Selectors finishing Tuesday night shall report to STUCON at 0730 Wednesday for selection paperwork.
3. Formation class Required Reading: Formation FTI, Formation Supplement, and Squadron SOP.
4. After FAM4501, complete FAM1205 CAI and pick up a Formation Supplement from Safety.
5. After I4103, complete SY0302 FMS TRAINER 2 in order to progress to I3201. Contact ODO after completion.
6. TAC 78 is backup frequency for all formation flights.
7. Prior to T-6 Ground School day 12, SNAs shall complete G6001 and SY0301. Contact ODO after completion.
8. Upon completion of T-6 Instrument Ground School day 3, SNAs shall complete CAI FAM1204 and FAM1205.
9. Students shall complete end of phase survey after FAM/INST/FORM/CAPSTONE checkride.
